blocks.x: Constitutional status for urban bodies, with three types by size.
blocks.in: **Nagar Panchayat, Municipal Council, Municipal Corporation**; **Ward Committees above 3 lakh (243S)**; **MPC above 10 lakh (243ZE)**; **Twelfth Schedule 18 subjects**; SEC and SFC as for panchayats.
blocks.gl: City governments in the US and Europe.
blocks.w: The urban tier is **constitutionally recognised and functionally starved**.

blocks.x: Own revenue is the weakest link in Indian federalism.
blocks.in: Municipal own revenue about **0.15% of GDP** against 2-8% comparably; property tax far below potential; **municipal bonds** since Pune (2017) used by a dozen cities.
blocks.gl: Property tax as the mainstay of US city finance.
blocks.w: Cities generate **over 60% of GDP** and control almost none of the revenue.

blocks.t: Mayor, commissioner and the elected council
blocks.x: An elected mayor with ceremonial power and an appointed commissioner with executive power.
blocks.in: Most Indian states use a weak-mayor model with short terms; some (e.g. Tamil Nadu, Kerala) have stronger councils.
blocks.gl: Directly elected executive mayors in London and New York.
blocks.w: Accountability is blurred when the **elected head cannot direct the executive**.

blocks.x: Constitutional mandate met in form, evaded in practice.
blocks.th: **Article 243U** requires elections before expiry of five years.
blocks.in: Councils left unconstituted in several states for long periods; **Smart Cities SPVs** delivering ₹1.64 lakh crore of projects while **bypassing the elected council**.
blocks.gl: Special purpose vehicles in urban development elsewhere.
blocks.w: The SPV is the sharpest available critique of the 74th Amendment's hollowing.

blocks.t: Urban planning and the missing tier
blocks.x: Metropolitan areas need a planning authority larger than any single municipality.
blocks.in: MPCs constituted rarely and rarely effective; parastatals (development authorities, water boards) hold real planning power.
blocks.w: Parastatals **outrank the elected municipality** in most Indian metros.

blocks.x: Central missions carry most urban investment.
blocks.in: **AMRUT and AMRUT 2.0**, **Smart Cities (closed 2025)**, **Swachh Bharat Urban 2.0**, **PMAY-U 2.0**, **NULM**; Swachh Survekshan as competitive ranking.
blocks.w: Missions build assets; they do not build **municipal capacity to run them**.

blocks.x: Governance has not kept pace with demographic reality.
blocks.in: 31.1% urban (2011) heading to ~40% by 2030; **3,892 census towns governed as villages**; only ~20-25% of urban sewage treated; urban flooding in Chennai, Mumbai, Bengaluru.
blocks.w: India's urbanisation is **under-counted and therefore under-governed**.
